title: The US dollar index as a lead for spot gold when gold lags it

rule.dxy: ICE DXY: 50.14348112 x EURUSD^-0.576 x USDJPY^0.136 x GBPUSD^-0.119 x USDCAD^0.091 x USDSEK^0.042 x USDCHF^0.036 on folded daily closes
rule.weekly: dollar weekly return z vs the 52 weeks before < -1 (long gold) or > 1 (short gold) and gold's lag e = g - beta x d below (above) 0 (beta from the same 52 weeks); entry next gold open, out at the close of the 5th gold candle
rule.daily: same with 250 days, held one candle
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: dollar index down > 1 sd in a week, gold lagged its co-move: long gold for the next week (primary)
dollar index up > 1 sd in a week, gold lagged: short gold for the next week (mirror)
dollar index day beyond 1 sd with gold lagging its co-move: gold against the dollar for the next day

info.what: T1 without the lag condition: every dollar down week > 1 sd, long gold (informational)
T2 without the lag condition: every dollar up week > 1 sd, short gold (informational)
T1 rule on the council's own DXY build (USD/SEK = 11.2 / EURUSD) (informational)
